carried_findings.substance: CRLF / EOL publication-proof fragility. No .gitattributes; core.autocrlf=true; tracked files already exist whose HEAD blob is LF while a clean working tree is CRLF. Publication proof compares live bytes to the HEAD blob, so a fresh clone could fail closed with U06_LIFECYCLE_NOT_PUBLISHED. Candidate R2 depends on exact publication containment for its promotion artifacts. Fail-closed, never fail-open. Inherited from A-05 / F-03 / J-04.
